question.problem:
Find the locations of all of the critical points of the transformation $T,$ where $T$ is defined as

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}u{v}^{2} \\ {u}^{2}+2v\end{aligned}].
$$

choices.value: The critical points lie on the line $v=0$ and on the hyperbola ${v}^{2}-{u}^{2}.$
The critical points lie on the lines $u=-2v$ and $u=v.$
The critical points lie on the parabola $u={v}^{2}.$
The critical points lie on the line $u=2v.$
The critical points lie on the line $v=0$ and on the parabola $v=2{u}^{2}.$
